A flowchart showing a simple food chain in a Nigerian savanna. Starting on the left with green Grass (Producer, 1st Trophic Level), an arrow points to a Grasshopper (Primary Consumer, 2nd Trophic Level), an arrow points to a Toad (Secondary Consumer, 3rd Trophic Level), an arrow points to a Snake (Tertiary Consumer, 4th Trophic Level), and a final arrow points to a Hawk (Top Carnivore). A large yellow Sun above points a ray of energy to the grass. Small red wavy arrows rise from every animal showing energy lost as heat.

A split illustration comparing environmental balance and disruption. Left half: A healthy landscape with a clear flowing river, dense green forest, various animals grazing peacefully, and a balanced scale floating in the sky. Right half: A degraded landscape with a dried-up muddy river, tree stumps from logging, a factory releasing thick black smoke into the air, and a broken scale floating in the sky.
